messages:
Priya: Saw an alert for ~2.8k untagged GPU spend this morning across two projects. Opening thread to decide temporary crediting vs owner outreach.

cost-bot: ALERT: Untagged GPU spend spike +37% vs 7d avg (2025-09-11). Top projects: sandbox-explore, experiments-ml. See alert/2334.

Jules: Pulled usage with this query to confirm labels:
```sql
SELECT project_id, labels, SUM(cost) AS cost
FROM billing.gpu_usage
WHERE usage_date = DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY)
GROUP BY project_id, labels
ORDER BY cost DESC
LIMIT 20;
```
Top rows: sandbox-explore null $1,700; experiments-ml team=ml $900 (no customer).

Rohit: Looks like sandbox-explore keeps getting missed by onboarding. Recommend: auto-soft-tag for <=$1k/day, manual review for >$1k.

Anya: For approvals: finance can absorb up to $3k total per event. Above that we escalate to Priya. Also require exclude when labels contain customer= or partner=.

Priya: Okay. Let's do: nightly detector flags untagged > $250/project-day; if project-day between $250 and $1k apply finance_temp=sandbox for 72h and create ticket FIN-6120. If still untagged after 72h, move to chargeback draft. Anything >$1k triggers pager to owners and finance lead review immediately.

Jules: I'll add `AND NOT REGEXP_CONTAINS(labels, r"customer=")` to the detection query and implement the 72h soft-tag logic in the tracking table (not changing cloud billing exports).

Rohit: Can we backfill last 14 days into the tracking table so smoothing works? I can run backfill and upload CSV to FIN-6120.

Anya: Yes backfill but set a guard: exclude any rows where inventory shows `provisioner IN ('infra-ci','playground-operator')` and customer tag exists. We don't want to misassign customer spend.

Priya: Action items: (1) Jules to deploy detector + soft-tag automation (tomorrow), (2) Rohit to run 14-day backfill and attach CSV to FIN-6120 (EOD), (3) Anya to update playbook with approval thresholds and escalate matrix (2 days). I'll approve finance credits up to $3k for this event now.

Jules: Will post commit link for the detector job. Also adding dashboard tile: "Untagged GPU spend (72h soft-tag)".

cost-bot: SCHEDULED: Untagged detection job set for 03:15 UTC nightly.

Priya: Good. Keep this thread as the audit trail for FIN-6120. If backfill shows >$3k internal, I'll review and decide whether to absorb or escalate.

Rohit: Backfill started. Will attach CSV shortly.

Anya: Noted. Will update playbook and ping for sign-off. :white_check_mark:
